children: that the mobile boomer shooter set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe is now available on mobile app stores.

The crusade comes to mobile in this new adaptation of the smash-hit boomer shooter series originally developed by Auroch Digital for PC and consoles. Purge with speed and strike with precision in this premium retro FPS, featuring different chapters from the Boltgun series. The game is now available on the Apple App Store and Google Play in all major markets.
"We were humbled by the reception and excitement during the pre-registration phase. We're now thrilled to put the game in the hands of players and look forward to hearing their feedback,"
says Jussi Tähtinen, CEO & Co-Founder of Nitro Games.

Nitro Games is a game developer and publisher, backed by a multinational team of gaming professionals with expertise spanning game development, publishing, and live operations. Specializing in action and shooter games, Nitro Games is dedicated to creating high-quality experiences for a global audience. The company has built a strong portfolio of engaging and innovative games. Nitro Games also has a proven history of collaborating with leading brands and companies, offering tailored development and publishing services to select partners.
Nitro Games' shares are listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market with the ticker NITRO. The Certified Adviser is FNCA Sweden AB.
